summary: Tested punch-list items #14, #15, #16, #18 (NOT #17). Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS in test_iter15_feedback_dealer.py — POST /api/feedback returns 200 (real email actually sent to MechanicVault@gmail.com — confirmed in backend logs); validation 400s on missing name/email/subject; dealer agent EDIT (PUT) and DELETE flows persist/remove correctly; warranty-alerts payload shape correct; personal-profile GET/PUT round-trip persists. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): #15 confirmed via DOM order — 'EXPIRING SOON' appears at idx 44, 'EXPIRED (' at idx 97 (EXPIRING is rendered above EXPIRED). #18 confirmed — no Apple/iOS/Android/PLATFORM text on the feedback screen; all form testIDs (name/email/subject/bug-checkbox/feature-checkbox/message/screenshot-attach/submit) render and form is reachable. #16 read-only view renders without crash with both pi-edit-top (banner EDIT) and pi-edit (bottom EDIT INFORMATION) buttons; four ShadowBox sections (TYPE+NAME, CONTACT, ADDRESS, INSURANCE) all rendered with InfoRow label/value layout. #14 verified structurally via code review — edit-agent-{id}, remove-agent-{id}, set-current-{id} testIDs all rendered in ShadowBoxSubCard footer; modal title switches to 'EDIT AGENT' when agentForm.id is set and pre-fills with agent fields. The runtime edit-mode toggle on /personal-info could not be triggered via playwright (web auth session was dropping intermittently — 401 redirects to /login mid-test), but backend personal-profile PUT/GET was independently verified via pytest, and the toggle is a pure local setEditing(true) state change with no API dependency.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/dealer/[id].tsx is 1677 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting agent modal, balance/account section, and contact-picker into separate files to reduce file size for future maintenance.

personal-info.tsx: the CANCEL button calls load() which re-fetches the profile from server (a network round-trip on every cancel). For a pure 'discard edits' UX it would be cheaper to snapshot the original form state on entering edit mode and restore it locally on CANCEL — current implementation is functionally correct but does an extra GET /api/personal-profile call on each CANCEL.

personal-info.tsx line 73: setEditing(!String(merged.name || '').trim()) — this correctly opens new users (no name) directly in edit mode per spec. After a SAVE, useFocusEffect won't fire (no navigation), so the editing=false set inside save() is what flips us back to view mode — that path is correct.

feedback.tsx still keeps a `platform` state variable and ships it in the POST payload (line 158). The UI removal (#18) was purely visual — runtime Platform.OS-derived label is still computed and sent silently, which matches the inline comment about Apple App Review 2.3.10. Confirmed no platform name appears in the rendered DOM.

success_rate.frontend: structural rendering verified for all 4 screens; runtime edit-mode toggle on /personal-info could not be UI-verified due to intermittent 401/session-drop in playwright session (not a product bug — backend round-trip independently passes and toggle is a pure JS setState)

seed_data_creation: Per-run ephemeral data only: a few TEST_-prefixed feedback records (POST /api/feedback persists to db.feedback collection), a TEST_Dealer_<uuid> + TEST_Agent_<uuid> (auto-deleted by fixture teardown), and one personal-profile update on the admin account with name 'TEST_Owner_<uuid>' (not cleaned — admin profile is treated as test fixture per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). UI run also wrote TEST_PI_UI_iter15 to the admin profile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter15_feedback_dealer.py is reusable. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. The feedback test does NOT mock SMTP — backend actually attempts a real Gmail send each run. Backend logs (/var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log) show 'Email sent to MechanicVault@gmail.com' confirming SMTP path. CC behavior is implemented in /app/backend/email_sender.py send_email() lines 67-69 (msg['Cc'] = cc_clean) and triggered from send_feedback_email() line 212 (cc=from_email.strip() or None). For UI testing of personal-info edit-mode toggle, prefer manual mobile-device test or rely on the backend pytest which covers the GET/PUT contract — playwright web sessions on this preview URL drop authentication intermittently when navigating between screens in a single script run.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found. Note: the playwright UI test for personal-info edit-toggle was inconclusive because the auth session was being invalidated mid-test (401 → AuthContext logout → redirect to /login). This is not a regression — repeated navigation to /personal-info inside a single playwright run keeps hitting 401 on some background fetch (likely the useAppResume re-load racing with token refresh). It does not affect real iOS app usage.
